visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with black-framed glasses wearing a mustard yellow t-shirt stands before a professional studio microphone mounted on a boom arm. He is holding a smartphone in his left hand and reciting dialogue with an expressive, focused face. A cartoon illustration of traditional characters from "Journey to the West" appears as a semi-transparent overlay at the bottom center. (2) A woman enters the frame from the right side, handing a second smartphone to the man in the yellow shirt. He reacts with a look of mock surprise, raising his right hand to his forehead. A second man in a grey t-shirt sits at a desk with an electronic keyboard, laptop, and dual monitors, partially turned toward the camera. (3) The man in the yellow shirt begins to sing passionately into the microphone while looking at the lyrics on the phone. The man at the keyboard plays along. Floating lyrics and credit text overlays appear in the center of the frame against a soft, colorful glow. (4) The woman reappears in the frame, clapping her hands enthusiastically while smiling at the camera. The man in the yellow shirt continues singing and then laughs towards the end of the sequence. The scene concludes with a graphic for the "Journey to the West" audio series and social media handles.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Action Challenge -> Performance -> Climax -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a promotional showcase for the 'Mom and Dad Telling Stories' (媽爹講故事) audio brand. It utilizes a behind-the-scenes recording studio narrative where the lead creator, Hua Ba, is challenged to sing a well-known theme song to prove his vocal range and the high production quality of their audiobooks for children.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the brand name '媽爹講故事' and promotion of their specific 'Journey to the West' audio series.
